title: Catalogue Range
story: A library catalogue is stored as a search tree: every label in a node's left branch is smaller than the node's label, and every label in its right branch is larger. How many labels lie between low and high, both included? Visiting every node takes too many steps for the largest catalogues; the tree's order tells you which branches can be skipped.

notes: Labels are different whole numbers from 1 to 100000.

hints: A node whose label is not above low has nothing useful on its LEFT; a node whose label is not below high has nothing useful on its RIGHT.
Walk the tree with a stack, and only PUSH a branch that can still hold labels in the range.
Both ends count: a label equal to low or to high is inside the range.
edgeCases: labels equal to low or high
a range with nothing in it
